issues.detail: Hebrew 'כִּי תֹאֲנָה הוּא מְבַקֵּשׁ מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים' means 'for he was seeking an occasion against the Philistines' (Samson seeking a pretext against the Philistines). The Vietnamese renders 'vì Ngài đang tìm kiếm dịp để chống lại người Phi-li-tin' ('because He [the LORD] is seeking an occasion against the Philistines'), changing the subject from Samson ('הוּא' = he) to God ('Ngài'), which alters who is doing the seeking.
